C9000206.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 206 (Finite lattice representation and undecidability.; papers: Finite congruence lattices: characterization and undecidability; A negative solution to the finite lattice representation problem; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/206.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_FIELD_SHIFT.statement: Under the actual retained-edge shortcut hypotheses of pkt:field-shifts, every normalizer satisfies gcd(f,f_prime) divides s-a and every packet has size at most 2v.

C_FIELD_SUPPORT.statement: Every actual retained edge has nonempty source support in one residue class modulo the gcd of its group field exponents, including unitary twisted tensors and characteristic-two B/C realizations.

C_FIELD_COMPAT.statement: The same shortcut normalizer induces compatible field exponents on both intermediate natural realizations, including graph operations and characteristic-two B/C changes.

C_FIELD_PACKET_ARITH.statement: Given the actual support and compatible-normalizer hypotheses, the arbitrary-parameter cyclic and diagram action implies synchronization and the 2v packet bound.

C_FIELD_COMBINATORIAL.statement: The universally quantified support-translation, progression noncollision, odd doubling, shortcut addition, and 2v finite-group bound are proved by the source-bound Lean 4.31.0 certificate; statement fidelity awaits independent review.

C_FIELD_CYCLE.statement: For every positive target exponent and every natural tensor-cycle length, actual cyclic fixed points have source exponent r=bt and digit support in one class modulo t; odd and even unitary cases have explicit finite-field descent and a nonsingular invariant Hermitian form.

C_FIELD_INNER_REMOVAL.statement: On a connected smooth classical factor product, a diagram-field-cycle endomorphism with zero differential has a single twisted-conjugacy orbit, so inner factors in the actual finite realization can be removed by conjugacy.

C_BC_SUPPORT_CHANGE.statement: The actual characteristic-two B/C pullback omega_1+omega_ell maps to omega_1+2*omega_ell and changes ordinary support from {0} to {0,1}; this refutes only an auxiliary stronger route, not a manuscript assertion.

C_NEG_MAIN.statement: main:congruences: Some finite nonempty lattice is not the congruence lattice of any finite nonempty algebra of finite signature.

C_NEG_GROUP.statement: main:group: Some finite lattice is not a full subgroup interval [D,G] in any finite group.

C_PALFY_PUDLAK.statement: The global universal finite congruence-lattice representation assertion is equivalent to the global universal finite-group subgroup-interval representation assertion; this is not pointwise equivalence for a fixed lattice.

C_NEG_FRAMEWORK.statement: The negative-solution manuscript's original-core factor transport and coordinate normal tests have the claimed subgroup-interval interpretations.

C_NEG_CLASSIFICATION.statement: The negative-solution manuscript's classical subgroup catalogue and reductions cover all relevant long differing-label chains uniformly.

C_NEG_REMAINING.statement: grw:remaining-paths: arbitrary-length reduced chains admit common-field classical endpoints and the five specified retained-path properties, including a single-digit nonlinear edge in each shortcut.

C_NEG_LIFTS.statement: lift:edge-lifts: retained inner projections have nested characteristic quasisimple components with soluble quotients, compatible actual finite inclusions, and the asserted rational natural-module edge maps.

C_NEG_LENGTH.statement: pkt:bounded-length: after fixed-spacing thinning, endpoint natural modules have absolute composition length at most 30B+62, uniformly in field degree.

C_NEG_PACKET_REDUCTION.statement: pkt:semisimple, pkt:centralizer, pkt:multiplicity, and pkt:one-packet supply the claimed semisimple section, multiplicity bound 15, and one-large-packet alternative.

C_NEG_RIGIDITY.statement: cls:chain-rigidity: the manuscript's tested differing-label chains have an absolute length bound, through natural-endpoint irreducibility and irreducible-restriction rigidity.

C_NEG_NATURAL_IRRED.statement: irr:natural-endpoints: in the remaining configurations, arbitrarily long chains have arbitrarily long subchains on which every natural endpoint module restricts absolutely irreducibly to each earlier endpoint.

C_NEG_DETECTOR.statement: The negative-solution manuscript's decorated Boolean rank-four lattice enforces all required forward and reverse chain tests while preserving the asserted joins, meets, and full intervals.

C_NEG_GLUE.statement: glue:contradiction: in a minimal subgroup-interval representation, the socle/action correspondence and proper-face extension compatibility force the forbidden full-union common extension.

C_FIN_MAIN.statement: m:main: the colored-graph characterization, undecidability of finite congruence representation, a finite description of the least counterexample with size greater than seven, and undecidability of finite subgroup-interval recognition all hold.

C_FIN_GRAPH.statement: f:criterion: the stated finite colored complete graph criterion is equivalent to full finite congruence-lattice representability, rather than only an embedding.

C_FIN_AFFINE.statement: f:negative-family and f:thm-almost-simple-reduction: the private affine-chart normal tests and extension-kernel exclusions yield the claimed full starting-interval obstruction and almost-simple reduction.

C_FIN_ANCESTORS.statement: r:reverse-exclusion, c:classical-conclusion, and c:alternating-conclusion hold uniformly for the protected ancestor paths.

C_FIN_WEIGHTED.statement: t:weighted-realization: every relevant finite realization admits the common cell alignment and simultaneous numerical readings encoding both addition and multiplication.

C_FIN_TEMPLATE.statement: n:template-bound: a computable template bound controls affirmative witness size independently of unknown encoded weights.

C_FIN_UNDECIDABLE.statement: n:undecidable: a finite-representability decider would decide Diophantine solvability by the claimed total effective reduction.

C_FIN_INTERVAL.statement: n:interval-undecidable: recognizing full finite-group subgroup intervals is undecidable, using an ambient-group-order bound rather than only an algebra-carrier-size bound.

C_FIN_MINIMUM.statement: q:minimum: explicit order-table formulas and a Busy Beaver bound finitely specify a minimum-cardinality nonrepresentable lattice, all smaller lattices are representable, and its size is greater than seven.
